prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity desktop website UI DESIGN CONCEPT image for adding an AI Try-on section to the existing ClozDesign T-shirt detail page. This is a flat straight-on browser content screenshot, no perspective device frame, no external presentation labels. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, exquisite legible typography and pixel-precise realistic web UI.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the existing garment detail page visual language: preserve ClozDesign brand wordmark, navigation, warm ivory background, ink-black fine lines and buttons, restrained acid-lime accent #cfff35. Images 2 and 3 are model photography references for casting and image quality, not UI backgrounds. Reuse the woman from image 2 in the main preview and the blond man from image 3 as a model choice. The garment to try on is the ivory oversized crewneck T-shirt from reference 1. The main model preview is the woman wearing that IVORY T-SHIRT and her butter-yellow trousers, maintaining the woman's identity and pose. Clean cutout photography on warm neutral stage, no hazy aura.

DESIGN DIRECTION: premium editorial fashion atelier with a highly usable integrated product feature, confident whitespace, strong typography and photo-led layout. Existing site navigation at top, slim white 66px bar: ClozDesign at left, 3D Models, White Mockups, Pricing, Guides, Tools in middle, Sign In and small black Start designing button right.
Under navigation a slim product context bar with breadcrumb '3D Models / T-shirt', product name 'Relaxed Crewneck T-Shirt', and small underlined 'Back to 3D' right. Then main integrated AI Try-on section on warm paper background within generous 56px side margins.
Heading row: small red uppercase 'AI TRY-ON' eyebrow; large elegant editorial serif headline 'Your design. Real presence.' and short quiet text 'Choose a model. Bring your T-shirt to life.' Top right small '01 / SELECT A MODEL' step marker. No fake model dimensions, no invented prices or timing.

Main workspace below, two columns: left model selection panel about 38% width, right large fashion preview stage about 62%.
LEFT: title 'Find your look' and compact real-looking outlined tabs 'All', 'Editorial', 'Everyday', 'Street', with All black selected. Under this, a precise 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX rectangular portrait model cards, diverse adult models with real fashion-photograph quality, distinctive hairstyles and outfits, around 110x145 portrait image each. First card is selected woman from image 2 in blue T-shirt, with thin black outline and tiny lime check in corner. Labels beneath images: 'Freja / Scandi', 'Leo / Coastal', 'Imani / Street', 'Mara / Editorial', 'Noah / Indie', 'Sofia / Everyday'. Names larger than style descriptors, clean hierarchy. Below grid thin divider then a compact 'YOUR DESIGN' horizontal row: small cutout ivory T-shirt thumbnail, 'Relaxed Crewneck' with secondary 'Current 3D design', discreet 'Edit' link right. Finally full-width acid-lime rectangular primary CTA with black text 'Generate try-on' and small simple sparkle icon plus right arrow. Beneath in small muted type 'AI-generated styling preview'.
RIGHT: a single large beautiful fashion preview stage pale beige, aligned height with model panel, subtle outline, minimal radius. The female model cutout wearing the ivory T-shirt occupies most of stage, complete head through upper thighs, never cropped at crown, face real and clear, premium fashion light. Top-left small black translucent caption 'TRY-ON PREVIEW'. Top-right segmented toggle 'Original / Try-on' with Try-on active. Bottom-left compact floating ivory caption 'Freja' with 'Scandi / Relaxed pose'. Bottom-right understated white square download icon button. Tiny source garment inset thumbnail in an unobtrusive 84px square at upper-left below caption, visually connecting garment and outcome. Model is main focal point.
At bottom of screen small understated horizontal process captions with hairline separators: '01 Choose a model', '02 Generate your look', '03 Save & share'. All elements spaced properly and legible. No purple gradients, no decorative AI blobs, no excessive rounded cards, no glowing effects, no dashboard charts, no dense settings. This is a CONCEPT of the generated-result state, not a claim of a real result. Render only the finished UI screenshot.
